spans.s:
daiva, a. of the gods, 57^21; coming from
the gods; divine; as n. divine appointment,
 i. e. fate, 18^12, etc. [devá, 1208f.]

daivata, a. pertaining to a divinity; as n.
 —1. a divinity or, collectively, the divinities,
 esp. that or those celebrated in any
Vedic hymn;
 —2. idol, 62^18. [devatā,
1208e.]

daivatya, at end of cpds, having…as
divinity, addressed to…, 63^5. [devatā,
1211.]

daivika, a. of the gods; divine. [deva,
1222e.]

daívya, a. of the gods; divine. [devá,
1211.]
